data.evaluation: Historically exposed validation/test remain development/replication, not fresh confirmation. No new result access from historical TEST by this campaign until separate review/unlock. New untouched confirmation requires at least40 canonical songs outside exposure ledger; absent means no fresh confirmation claim.
data.grouping: Canonical music family before windows/recordings/coaches/augmentations. Quarantine ambiguous duplicates; balance song->recording->coach. RPMC excluded from confirmatory arms unless original35-performance mapping is recovered.
data.rhythm: Independent annotations required. Beat This final/small overlap with GuitarSet/Harmonix; AIO all-fold ensemble overlaps all Harmonix. Exclude known training overlap for unseen-song claim, otherwise explicitly descriptive tracker benchmark only. No detector self-evidence as truth.
data.targets: Common color-only target and separate intensity/accent target; no six-stat joint novelty relabelled as color. Fine audio beat labels separate from10Hz visual targets. Frozen training-only transforms/thresholds/vocabulary. Game background is authored video, not console DMX truth.

representation.student_audio: 40Hz64mel+28current scalars+2provenance-tagged rhythm probabilities (94 dimensions); high-resolution acoustic skip retained; slow encoder at10Hz after4xpooling.
representation.visual_rich: 96 dimensions: joint12x6HS histogram with achromatic/dark validity, plus4quadrants x6 chromatic/coverage features. Extract from source video with exact timestamps. Do not reconstruct joint/spatial features from saved marginal histograms.
representation.visual_legacy: Existing6scene statistics only as training auxiliary comparator; not lighting ground truth.
representation.pose_aux: 4 validated2D-derived summaries: vertical bounce amplitude, hand spread, quantity of motion, head speed; masks for gaps/cuts/coach tracking. No absolute KE->dimmer or footfall->beat labels.
representation.palette: TRAIN-fitted32-entry palette vocabulary; discrete conditional mark distribution with explicit keep/state history and generated previous tokens. No framewise absoluteRGBMSE. Shared vocabulary and cue times for state ablations.
representation.mask_comparison: Existing box masks versus learned SAM2 human masks prompted by existing pose boxes. UI mask identical. Stream mask summaries; do not persist full masks. Independent annotated frame subset plus known-background compositing; moving-mask/frozen-background negative control; no self-scoring on extraction-defined truth.

training.independent_match: Deterministic width search before data access for total active trainable parameters within5%; same receptive field and effective task frames. Report FLOPs/walltime separately, never assert all compute equal.
training.loss: Separate calibrated BCE event heads, categorical palette mark crossentropy; TRAIN-standardized auxiliary losses. Exact coefficient/config/source hashes must be registered before fit. No architecture rescue or luckyseed selection after outcomes.
training.rollout: Previous generated palette states and generated cue history at evaluation; reference histories forbidden. Training generated-history/state-dropout procedure must be frozen and tested before fit.
training.checkpoint_selection: Same predeclared scalar taskloss ondevelopment for all arms, fixed check intervals300updates. Report final and selected checkpoints; no test selection.
training.confirmation: Not automatic. Requires unexposed cohort and a separately frozen continuation; three developmentseeds do not become independent confirmatory experiments.
